candidates.title: Sissy Squat Correct Form | Gareth Sapstead
Sissy Squat Tutorial | Best Quad Isolation Exercise for Muscle Growth
candidates.description:
The sissy squat is a fantastic alternative to leg extensions, offering a full range of motion (ROM) for optimal quad activation and growth. Unlike leg extensions, which often lack a full stretch, sissy squats target your quads effectively while also engaging your core for stability.

In this video, I break down how to perform the sissy squat safely and effectively to maximize your quad gains—especially the rectus femoris, which can be under-stimulated during traditional compound movements like squats. Whether you're looking to build stronger, bigger quads or enhance your lower-body training, this is the perfect knee-extension isolation exercise to add to your program.

candidates.title: Sissy Squat Progression
candidates.description:
The sissy squat.
But there’s nothing “sissy” about it.

It’s a tough movement in many ways.

It’s an advanced quad-focused exercise that teaches dynamic balance, mobility, and strength.

Don’t dive into these head first.

As soon as you can manage 2-3 sets of 4-5 reps, you’re ready for the next variation.

What level are you at?
